newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-HEERENVEEN STORM INTO DUTCH CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HEERENVEEN STORM INTO DUTCH CUP FINAL.

text.p: Heerenveen trounced second division Helmond Sport 5-0 on Thursday to secure a place in the Dutch Cup final against Roda JC Kerkrade on May 8.

English premier league Newcastle United's manager Kenny Dalglish was at the semifinal to watch Heerenveen's Danish midfielder Jon Dahl Tomasson, the Dutch league's top scorer with 18 goals this season.
Tomasson struck the first goal in the 13th minute and by halftime, Leroy Echteld, Ole Tobiassen and Russian striker Igor Korneev had all added their names to the scoresheet.
Heerenveen, who lost the 1992 Dutch Cup final 6-2 to Ajax, added one more goal after the break through Borre Meinseth.
Kerkrade reached the final, to be played in Rotterdam, by beating Willem II Tilburg 1-0 on Wednesday.
